results.title: Roblox Creator Roadmap
results.content: * **In-Experience Creation of Clothing & Accessories** — Allows creators to publish experiences where users can create and purchase custom clothing and accessories in-experience that they can save to their inventory to wear across the platform. **In-Experience Auto Setup** — Enable developers to integrate the Auto Setup APIs directly into experience, allowing users to convert 3D models into fully functional Roblox-ready avatars, clothing, and accessories. * **Moments APIs** — A new set of APIs to help creators build their own in-experience content creation, sharing, and discovery systems. * **Improved asset previews and details on Creator Store** — Adding support for new ways to showcase and preview different asset types on the Creator Store with features like embedded videos, interactive previews, technical details, and more. **Content Moderation API** — Enable creators to validate the safety of user-generated in-game assets. **Player-Creator Helpdesk** — Enable your players to request support relating to your experience (e.g. bug reports, data loss/restore, purchase issues, ban appeals, feature requests).
